title: Robust consensus nuclear and cell segmentation
license: CC BY (as stated by the article)
claim_paraphrase: CellSampler runs established segmentation methods and combines masks using local consensus; its outputs include individual-cell property catalogs. Comparing and combining multiple masks is established prior art.
reliability_notes: Primary peer-reviewed methods paper. Reported task/datasets and scores are not a direct NucleiLens comparison. No performance superiority is inferred.
product_consequence: Do not position multi-model aggregation, split/merge analysis, mask editing, or cell measurements as scientific firsts. Assess concrete workflow usefulness and reproducibility.
